summary: John's 5th great-grandfather; day labourer of Munzingen, possibly earlier a seigneurial official ('herrschaftl. Waibel[?]').
bio: Johann Evangelist Birkenmayer was born 10 Jan 1771 and died at Munzingen 17 Dec 1844 (No. 14), buried 20 Dec: 'Johann Ev. Birkenmayer, alt 73 Jahre und 11 Monate, Wittwer und Taglöhner dahier. Geboren den 10ten Jenner 1771'. The 1836 marriage of his son calls him 'Johann Birkenmayer, herrschaftl. Waibel[?]' (reading uncertain; a seigneurial bailiff/beadle) and his wife Magdalena Erb deceased. The 'E.' in the tree is Evangelist. The Dreisamtal database never found him because he lived in Munzingen; the nearest Kirchzarten man, Johann Birkenmaier (1762–8 Sep 1847) married to Gertrud Steinhart (GEDBAS 1420125755), is a different person. Other Munzingen Birkenmayers of his time: Johannes Birkenmayer, father of Maria Anna (1810–1865, m. Salesius Schuhmacher); Johann Birkenmeier b. 1808 (mason in Basel); infant deaths 1832; mason Anton Birkenmaier; a Joseph Birkenmaier witness 1810 — relationships unworked. The tree gives him parents Matthias Birkenmayer (1739–1803) and Caecilia Hohler (1752–).
